Class TraaSAdapter

java.lang.Object
TraaSAdapter
public class TraaSAdapter extends Object
Adapter class for communicating with SUMO via the TraCI (Traffic Control Interface) protocol.

This class wraps the TraaS (TraCI as a Service) library and provides simplified methods for:

  • Querying simulation state (time, vehicle positions, angles, speeds, signals)
  • Querying and controlling traffic lights (state, program)
  • Adding vehicles and routes dynamically during simulation
  • Finding valid routes between edges using SUMO's routing

All methods may throw exceptions if the TraCI connection is not established or if SUMO returns an error (e.g., invalid vehicle ID, route not found).

    • getVehicleSignals

      public int getVehicleSignals(String id) throws Exception
      Returns the signal state of a vehicle (turn signals, brake lights). The result is a bit field where:
      • Bit 0 (1): Right turn signal
      • Bit 1 (2): Left turn signal
      • Bit 2 (4): Emergency flashers (both turn signals)
      • Bit 3 (8): Brake lights
      Parameters:
      id - The vehicle identifier
      Returns:
      Signal state as an integer bit field
      Throws:
      Exception - if TraCI communication fails or vehicle doesn't exist

    • getTrafficLightState

      public String getTrafficLightState(String tlId) throws Exception
      Returns the current state of a traffic light as a string of signal characters. Each character represents one signal: 'r'/'R' = red, 'y'/'Y' = yellow, 'g'/'G' = green, 'o' = off.
      Parameters:
      tlId - The traffic light (junction) identifier
      Returns:
      State string (e.g., "GrGr" for a 4-signal light)
      Throws:
      Exception - if TraCI communication fails or traffic light doesn't exist

    • setTrafficLightState

      public void setTrafficLightState(String tlId, String state) throws Exception
      Sets the state of a traffic light manually. This overrides automatic control until setTrafficLightProgram is called.
      Parameters:
      tlId - The traffic light (junction) identifier
      state - State string (e.g., "GGrr") where each character controls one signal
      Throws:
      Exception - if TraCI communication fails or state is invalid

    • findRoute

      public List<String> findRoute(String fromEdge, String toEdge) throws Exception
      Finds a valid route between two edges using SUMO's built-in routing algorithm. This respects the network topology and returns the shortest path.
      Parameters:
      fromEdge - Starting edge ID
      toEdge - Destination edge ID
      Returns:
      List of edge IDs forming the route, or null if no route exists
      Throws:
      Exception - if TraCI communication fails or edges don't exist
